name: Ca ro nuong
summary: Grilled perch. Vietnamese Wikipedia’s Hang Bụt paragraph says visitors cook what they catch, and names cá rô nướng, canh cua, and cà muối. The same paragraph places the cave 1 km from chùa Bích Động and then says the current Hang Bụt visit is in Sơn Hà. Both locations stay. This is not a restaurant dish of thôn Văn Lâm. A seasoning is Check on arrival.
origin: Hang Bụt, 1 km from chùa Bích Động on one sentence and Sơn Hà on the next.
howToEat: Visitors cook it themselves during that cave visit. A seasoning is Check on arrival.
where: Hang Bụt, with both the Bích Động distance and the Sơn Hà sentence kept. A clock hour is Check on arrival.
